comparison.objective: Secure an upright gas cylinder to a wall bracket with its chain.
comparison.physical_skill: Route articulated chain around a heavy cylinder, select and place a link on a J-hook, and maintain valve clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Chain snug and correctly hooked at prescribed height, cylinder upright against cradle, hands clear, and restraint passes a 10 N pull test.
comparison.reason: Tests articulated-chain routing and load restraint rather than tool-mediated fracture and fragment collection.
